decisions.reason: As a flagship multi-model line close to the core software business and publicly tied to the firm's digital direction, management is likely to continue backing it despite any mixed signals.
The education institute is adjacent to the firm's support and training capabilities, so even with more modest visibility management has reasons to justify and extend the 2018 commitment.
A remote support tool fits the established service offering closely and likely required limited incremental investment, making continued retention more likely than withdrawal.
The analytics dashboard sits squarely in the firm's stated push toward more digital and efficiently managed practices, so management is inclined to persist with it.
A complete practice bundle is very close to the core offer and represents a visible commercial packaging choice that management is likely to maintain.

The job and practice listing portal is the most distant from the firm's established business and appears less publicly central, so it is the easiest product to abandon and reallocate resources away from.
